Why you may ask? Because I'm simulating the Erene world cup on xKoranate, and those styles which differ from five to negative five depends.

Positive style numbers (e.g., +2, +4) typically indicate a more aggressive, attacking, or high-risk style of play. This tends to increase both the likelihood of scoring goals/points and the likelihood of conceding them.
Negative style numbers (e.g., -2, -4.5) generally represent a more defensive, cautious, or physical approach, such as playing with many players behind the ball or focusing on counterattacks. This tends to decrease the odds of both scoring and conceding.
A style number of 0 (or no modifier) suggests a balanced or neutral approach.
